finding: Original and repaired models have numerical equality. Pickle differences are positive/negative zero encodings in HGB training bin thresholds and learned num_threshold fields propagated from those bins. Tree leaf values and all other fields remain byte-identical.
bounded_equivalence_rule: Require all outputs/actions/results byte-identical. For differing model pickles, allow only exact old/new byte payloads of HGB bin-threshold arrays or node arrays whose sole difference is the signbit of a zero num_threshold. Validate each affected numerical array and every other node field. Compare EVERY original pickle opcode, offset and argument; no other difference is permitted. Counts must match. Original files are never changed.
why_equivalent: For real finite inputs,x<=-0.0 equals x<=+0.0. Every allowed difference is only the sign of a zero comparison threshold; leaf values and branch topology remain identical.
discarded_check: Re-pickling loaded objects is not used as a byte identity proof because reserialization can change pickle reference layout; compare original pickle opcodes and payloads directly.
